body:
[A10] Newly discovered during the review of PR #107 (R270-1 S2 and section 7 item 3, https://github.com/Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan/pull/107#issuecomment-5801267950).

## Observed
The processor's own leavealltimer does not restart when it receives a LeaveAll. docs/architecture/10_srp_engine.md section 6.5 (lines 402-411 at PR #107 head fc155c3c) records this as an open deviation. The behaviour predates #106 and PR #107 leaves it unchanged.

## Authority
IEEE 802.1Q-2014 Table 10-5 (LeaveAll state machine): rLA! gives "Start leavealltimer, Passive". Clause 10.6 says the same in prose. Clause 10.7.5.20 NOTE makes LeaveAll per attribute type; the timer and Passive rule are to be applied consistently with that scoping, as #106 applies it to registrars.

## Scope
Implement the rLA! row of Table 10-5: restart the leavealltimer and enter Passive, so the processor does not send its own LeaveAll while a peer's LeaveAll has just served the purpose. Any per-attribute-type interpretation must be stated with the clause. Tests pin the restart and the Passive suppression, each with a failing arm. Docs section 6.5 drops the deviation.

## Acceptance
1. Encoder and receive path follow Table 10-5 rLA!, with tests and mutants.
2. docs 10 section 6.5 and docs/10_RESOURCE_AND_EFFORT.md agree with the implementation and cite the clause.
3. Donor gates plus the parent consumer gates with the gitlink staged or locally committed pass.

Priority: after #106 (PR #107). This does not block the #530 silicon rerun: the rerun's defect was the scope of a received LeaveAll, not the timer.

comments.body: [A10] Cross-reference: #29 tracked this same deviation (a received LeaveAll does not restart the leavealltimer). It is closed as a duplicate of this issue, which keeps the clause-level acceptance and is the target of PR #107's docs pointer.

[A10] Lane C1 of the PP program (milan-fpga #415 comment 5883685470, owner decision 2026-09-29): SRP/MVRP timers and LeaveAll. Executor [A437], on branch `c1-srp-mrp-timers` from `main` `c951a9ff`. Reviewers [R398] (internal) and [R399] (external).

The lane covers #29 and #108, which describe the same defect and are resolved once, plus #64 and #65. The PR closes all four. Parent evidence owner: milan-fpga #76.

**Items, in order, one or more commits each:**

1. **#29 = #108: a received LeaveAll restarts the leavealltimer and enters Passive** (802.1Q-2014 Table 10-5 rLA!, clause 10.6).
   - Apply it per attribute type, consistently with the 10.7.5.20 NOTE scoping that #106 applies to registrars. State the interpretation with the clause.
   - Change `dec_la_msrp_w`, and the MVRP equivalent, so they re-arm the LeaveAll cadence draw.
   - **Tests:**
     - an F4-style probe with peer LeaveAlls at 1 Hz: no own LeaveAll inside N peer cycles;
     - the restart pinned;
     - a mutant restoring expiry-only re-draw turns red.
   - `docs/architecture/10_srp_engine.md` section 6.5 drops the deviation; `docs/10_RESOURCE_AND_EFFORT.md` agrees.
2. **#64: grade the MRP timers in `tb/srp_top` against Milan Table 4.3** (REQ-SRP-001).
   - Timestamp every captured MRPDU and assert:
     - join-paced spacing of 180-240 ms;
     - periodic! every 900-1500 ms;
     - the first own MSRP and MVRP LeaveAll no earlier than 10 s after arming, and consecutive own LeaveAlls 10-15 s apart, with no peer LeaveAll in that window;
     - after item 1: a peer LeaveAll restarts the timer, so the next own LeaveAll comes 10 s or more after the peer's.
   - Mutations `JOIN_MS_P=400`, `PERIODIC_MS_P=3000` and `draw_kind_o=3'd0` each turn red, and are recorded in `tb/srp_top/README.md`.
3. **#65: MVRP join before the stream** (REQ-SRP-006; Milan 4.2.7.3, 4.3.2, 4.4.1).
   - The talker's streaming licence must not open before the MVRP declaration of the stream VID has been transmitted.
   - The listener's settled VID must be declared on the wire.
   - Write the design in HANDOFF.md first. **STOP before implementing it** if it:
     - needs a new top-level port or a parent-visible change;
     - or delays the first talker bind by more than one join-paced MRPDU (parent #606 measures bind latency).
   - Tests on both halves, each with a mutant.
4. **Parent-visible list** for the pin-adoption lane, in the PR body, even if empty.

**Gates:**
- every processor suite and entry point rc 0, with the mutants;
- the parent consumer set (the manager's 16 commands) in a scratch parent at milan-fpga dev `13eda870`, with the gitlink at your head. Report each failure with its attribution.

Do not edit or delete any existing comment.
[A437] REVIEW READY: head 81b8d6d7c4e2d90c5ab0f2e772a0991166945c3b on branch c1-srp-mrp-timers (not pushed).

title: Restart the leavealltimer and go Passive on a received LeaveAll (802.1Q-2014 Table 10-5, 10.6)
